docs.purpose: Powers an admin analytics dashboard summarising city-wide construction permit activity — monthly volumes and dollar values, breakdowns by trade, residential versus commercial split, and neighbourhood wealth-tier trends — so the business can gauge overall market conditions.
docs.data_story: It reads 4 tables — `permits`, `mv_monthly_permit_stats`, `trades` and `neighbourhoods` and writes nothing. Its response shape is **unmeasured** as a pick-by-name whitelist — it passes rows through, spreads a row into a computed object, or assembles the payload dynamically, so there is no single list naming what leaves the server. It is called from 1 place: `admin_market_metrics`.
docs.under_126: Becomes a **CONTRACT descriptor** of archetype `QUERY`. It declares its `database.reads[]` with named columns, its response projection as an explicit whitelist, its auth class, its rate bucket and its staleness — and `outputs.writes` is forced to `"none"`. Its `consumers[]` becomes the edge list of the fan-out graph — the join nothing in this estate holds today.
